metadata.title: The optimal diameter estimate for positive Yamabe metrics
metadata.abstract: In this paper, we prove the optimal diameter estimate for positive Yamabe metrics on a connected, closed manifold. It is a scalar curvature version of both classical Myers' diameter estimate and Cheng's maximal diameter theorem on Ricci curvature.
